purpose: Join each raw EDDB magnetics channel (flux loops, tangential probes, normal probes) to its geometry-input sensor position via the shared sensor index, for the ambix machine map.

standalone_default.note: SELENE's standalone default. Not the geometry-input count: eqinpu96.f:221-222 overrides IPROB/ILOOP from the getseldata namelist (27/17), which outeddb.c writes from FXMAX/PBMAX. The receipt's flux list uses the geometry-input count 27.

geometry_input.note: inpgeo.c reads probes (108-115) then flux (117-124) into rprb/zprb/omeg and rflx/zflx. outeddb.c writes those arrays as RPOST/ZPOST/DMPT0 and RPOSLP/ZPOSLP in the SELENE namelist.

shared_index_mechanism: A raw channel joins its position only through the shared sensor index: geteddb.c reads EDDB channel (icnt+1) into measured array slot icnt, and inpgeo.c fills the position array slot icnt from the geo.in row at the same ordinal. SELENE then binds position->grid cell via MGPOS (mgprc.f:14-28, eqvacu.f:211-227); JLOOP/JTPRB/JNPRB in inc/#MAG are grid-cell indices, not a channel map.
